caption: One handoff. The caller is not asked anything twice.

lines.text: Who am I speaking with, and what can I help with?
Dana Whitfield. There is a charge on my bill I do not recognise.

lines.note: caller_name, intake_reason and verified are written to the shared context, then the call connects to the billing specialist.

lines.text: Thanks Dana, connecting you to billing.

lines.text: Hi Dana - I see you are asking about an unrecognised charge. Let me pull that up.
It came through with your call.
